english.title: Fail to notify the official veterinary surgeon at the border inspection post of arrival of required information

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the case of transhipment of animal products, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCTS..), being the person responsible for a consignment failed to notify **(..SPECIFY NAME OF VETERINARY SURGEON..), the official veterinary surgeon at the border inspection post of arrival, namely **(..SPECIFY BORDER INSPECTION POST..), at the time of arrival, of the information required under regulation 14(4) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION THAT WAS NOT DISCLOSED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(4), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
